name: java-backend-api-standard
title_zh: API 契约先于代码的 Spring Boot 接口
tagline_zh: 写接口前先定契约：统一响应、错误码、reqid、签名、幂等、分页，一次说清。不靠记忆，靠规则，评审不再吵格式。
tagline_en: Define response envelope, error codes, reqid, signing, idempotency, pagination before coding. Stop format debates.
desc_en: Use when Java/Spring Boot 任务需要定义或检查 HTTP/API 契约、统一响应、错误码、reqid、请求头、参数校验、认证鉴权、签名、防重放、幂等、分页、OpenAPI 或 API 静态合规；具体实现、脚手架、多模块和 Netty 协议细节由对应专项 skill 承接。
why_zh: 把 API 规范变成可检查的规则集，在写代码前就拦截不一致，而不是事后补文档。
why_en: Turns API conventions into checkable rules, catching inconsistencies before code exists, not after.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 HTTP/API 契约与静态合规，不碰具体实现、脚手架、多模块或 Netty 协议细节。
limit_en: Only HTTP/API contract & static compliance; no implementation, scaffolding, multi-module, or Netty details.
title_en: Spring Boot API contract gatekeeper before code
